report_title: Final commitment: exact sparse row reformulation

shape.source: 13,873 vars / 3,202 rows / 79,655 constraint nonzeros / 115 integers / 2,610,500 B MPS

reformulation: Exact same-coordinate reduction of the test79 telecom MPS (Bienstock): 181 dense <= cuts c3022..c3202 are rewritten as old - BAL_st + D_st*IN_t with both operand rows retained equalities (their coefficients fall 10,984 -> 1,324), and 15 duplicate >= rows c2831..c2859 are deleted; every variable, bound record, integrality marker, objective coefficient and all other rows/RHS are unchanged: 3,202 -> 3,187 rows, 79,655 -> 69,965 nonzeros (-12.16%), no strengthening.
claim_class: Same-coordinate feasible-set equality in both integer and LP modes: 4 claims (source->target and target->source, each with and without integrality), objective relation Equal, identity projection on all 13,873 coordinates, both affine inverse identities; 181,792 obligations, all discharged by direct row reuse plus 754 Lin row-combination steps.
claims: 4 claims = (integer, LP) x (forward, reverse); objective 'Equal' in all; inverse pairing [1,0,3,2]; projection is the full identity on all 13,873 coordinates (no variable changes) in every claim

Obligations 45,498 / 45,513 / 45,383 / 45,398 (181,792 total); a forward claim = 13,873 VarLower + 576 VarUpper + 1,224 RowEq + 1,217 RowLower + 565 RowUpper + 181 Locals for the rewritten rows + 27,747 'Exact' entry rows (27,862 when integrality is required)
Steps per block 181 / 196 / 181 / 196: forward claims need one Lin step per rewritten row, reverse claims need 15 more, recovering each deleted duplicate from its retained twin

Every step is kind 'Le', constant '0', 1 or 3 terms: block 0 step 0 = [[RowUpper 3021,'1'],[RowEq 1097,'-1'],[RowEq 28,'21']] i.e. c3022 - BALae + 21*INe; a reverse duplicate step is the single term [RowLower 2829,'1']
Retained rows keep direct references in both directions, so only the edit needs steps; verify 0.99 s, work 19,580,432 -> 1,940,098 after the sparse accumulator change
proof_encoding: 'RPA 1' + one JSON object {claims, blocks}; 4 blocks of Lin steps each ending Return{map, checks}; proof.rpa 5,044,716 B -> proof.rpx 3,466,070 B
Byte composition: claims 688,451 B, four identical Return maps 2,119,752 B (42%), 754 steps 90,292 B, 181,792 checks 2,146,004 B
Blocks 0 and 2 hold byte-identical step arrays, as do blocks 1 and 3; only the 'Exact' integrality entries differ (27,862 vs 27,747)
Each Return map is 4 copies of the identity, [{constant:'0',terms:[[i,'1']]}] for i in 0..13,872, 529,938 B each
request.json 688,452 B is the claims array alone: 4 x 13,873 identity projection pairs plus the inverse indices
agent_manual_work: Wrote its own exact-Fraction MPS parser and cross-checked every record against fixed-column fields (ROWS 3,203 / COLUMNS 43,643 / RHS 500 / BOUNDS 600); that cross-check failed once on the MARKER line layout

Found the 181 rows by incidence (>= 54 terms, sense L), then asserted per row: one commodity index s, one negative target t, D = rhs(BALst) > 0, complement sets of 2..7 tail nodes, coefficient signs and RHS

Invented the certificate schema in audit.json: row_rewrites[].balance_row/degree_row/balance_multiplier/degree_multiplier/rhs_before/rhs_after/nonzeros_before/after/complement_tail_nodes, duplicate_deletions[].deleted/retained, changed_row_coefficients before/after

Hand-serialized the reformulated MPS with an exact decimal formatter (decstr, 12-char fields, exponent-free), re-emitted the integer markers, and copied the source BOUNDS records verbatim rather than re-deriving them

Wrote a second independent verifier (output/verify.py, 132 lines, fixed-column parser, Fractions) checking both identity directions, duplicate signatures, hashes and counts; rejected the box-tautology hypothesis via bound-activity ratios 2..7
preparer_helpers: tools/prepare_affine.py (233 lines) serves cases 79, 68, 33, 65; tools/prepare_test79.py is a 4-line wrapper calling run(79)
parse_mps (:20-76) hand-rolled MPS reader with Fractions, markers, RHS/BOUNDS defaults; row_ref (:77) and get_fact (:80) map sense -> RowEq/RowUpper/RowLower and bounds -> expression
load_hints (:91-100) 4-way case dispatch over the agent's audit.json keys; derivation (:101-119) case-79 branch returns [[row,1],[BAL,-1],[IN,D]] from agent-supplied names and multipliers
block (:122-148) hand-assembles the obligation ladder (var bounds, rows, objective, 2x|V| 'Exact') and the Lin steps, asserting computed == expected at :139
run (:151-172) globs the run output for one .mps, re-parses source and target, unrolls 'inverse':[1,0,3,2], writes compact RPA/request, shells out to rpx canonical/assemble/verify
friction: 16 turns / 15 tool calls / 1 failure / 305 s; the failure was the fixed-column MARKER assertion (/tmp/rpx-digests/test79.md:500), i.e. parsing, not mathematics

No API applies the edit: the target is an artifact written outside the toolchain (hand decimal writer, BOUNDS spliced verbatim) and then re-parsed, bound to the source only by a sha256 in preparation.json
The edit description lives in agent-invented JSON, so certificate content depends on audit.json key names and every prepare_affine case needs its own load_hints/derivation branch

Refs are per-claim input indices that rebase with the 15 deletions (c3022 is index 3021 in source, 3006 in target) and are computed from the preparer's own parse, not from the canonical MCM the verifier uses

42% of the RPA is one repeated map: 2,119,752 B of four identical identity Return maps, while the 688,452 B request repeats the same 13,873-pair identity projection 4x; there is no way to say 'identity' once
